messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "initiate treatment in autumn prior to onset of depressive symptoms"
set: ["initiate treatment in autumn prior to onset of depressive symptoms", "acute and maintenance treatment of major depressive disorder", "major depressive disorder in adults", "partial onset seizures", "storage allowed prior to cap removal", "major depressive disorder", "screen for personal or family history of bipolar disorder, mania, or hypomania prior to initiating treatment", "symptoms of anxiety", "partial onset seizures (add-on)", "pattern refers to seasonal major depressive episodes", "bipolar I depressive episodes", "Major depressive disorder (MDD)", "administered immediately prior to or following anesthesia induction", "consider duration of treatment", "four months of treatment", "complete program of treatment"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
